issue_request: FHIR-17457 asked what it means when Group.characteristic and Group.member are both present. Its Published/Persuasive resolution says listed members are individuals found to meet the characteristic; other qualifying candidates may be absent from the list; listed members cannot fail the listed characteristics.

FHIR-56092 is a later Triaged/Unresolved clarity proposal and is not a final decision. The cited Zulip patient roster thread supports the current source wording, and no Confluence reference or conflicting community record was found.
